entities.name: Tampere Lenin Museum
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Tampere Lenin Museum was a museum devoted to Vladimir Lenin in Tampere, Finland. It was established in 1946 by the Finland–Soviet Union Society, and later was run by The Finnish Labour Museum Werstas. It was the first museum dedicated to Lenin outside the Soviet Union.
